## Decisions
- Four-stage sequence is a hypothesis, not a frame. Elite-first and joint-production cases enter the cohort.
- Laundering coded as three separable transformations: wording, messenger, attributed origin. Allegation-altered is a fourth code, not laundering.
- Pilot window: 1 Sept to 15 Oct 2024. No scraping, no transcription: USC Telegram + 4plebs (fringe); Tenet transcripts + YouTube captions (intermediary); Truth Social dataset + Factba.se (elite).
- Experiment is a separate chapter; computational cohort is the core.
- Repository + Quarto site is the workspace. Raw data lives in a bucket, never in the repo.

## Done
- Gap paper drafted and revised against three rounds of feedback.
- Transmission framework memo with diagrams.
- Data inventory: existing 2024 datasets cover three of four tiers.
